context: Request: the matter with the firm's most recent FERC work (for a pitch). Rubric: 1016-00005 (Dunmore Energy / Ridgeline Midstream FERC rate and interconnection proceeding), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a glob of the empty output folder.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads memos, a spreadsheet and emails of the matter at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Shell loop unzipping each document and grepping for the request's key acronym; prints nothing.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a first response saying no matching matter exists in the store.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: After writing, a recursive grep -Ril over the store for the acronym and related terms lists files in several matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads seven emails and a filing across five matters from that list.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of three candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads status reports, memos and letters from two candidates to date their latest work.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Overwrites the response, naming one matter.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Write the response → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads four large documents of the matter at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script: a syntax error, then a rerun that times out after about 48K chars.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of one matter that appeared in the partial output.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script matching only the request's key acronym and printing snippets; lists files in several matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads four filings and letters of the matter it picked, with large limits.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the response naming one matter.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find (no output) plus whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads memos, an email and an engagement letter of the matter at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script over documents and emails; times out after about 97K chars.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Byte-match scan of document text for the key acronym plus a find | grep over file paths in the same command.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads opening memos, analyses and letters from three candidate matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads six more filings and memos of the matter it picked.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the response naming one matter.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run

divergence: Shared procedure: each run first read documents of the matter at the top of the listing, then searched document text store-wide for the request's key acronym (T1 and T2 with an extraction script narrowed after a syntax error or timeout; T0 with grep -Ril after an empty unzip loop and a provisional 'none found' response), which listed the candidate matters; each then read the picked matter's status reports and filings to date its latest work, and all three named the same matter.
